payload.body: You are good at wanting things from a distance. The tab stays open for weeks, the crush stays unspoken, the plan stays hypothetical. Whenever something you want becomes available, you find a reason the timing is wrong. Underneath there is usually an old lesson that your wanting was too much, too expensive, too selfish, or too strange, so desire learned to wait for a permission that never comes. Working through it starts small: buy the thing, name the preference, and let the discomfort pass.
payload.astroHint: Lilith square Venus can make it hard to act on a desire, even one you have carried for a long time.
